original_test_intent: Verify every DIMM in the approved 1DPC population remains stable during 12 hours of memory stress at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails without hangs or memory/platform errors.
original_method: Power down and use ESD controls to install the exact approved 1DPC socket/channel population; record DIMM serial/PN/capacity and training baseline; establish controlled chamber/rail margin; run an approved memory workload sized and affined to cover all sockets/channels for 12 hours while collecting utilization, bandwidth, temperatures, ECC/MCE/RAS and platform events; stop on defined limits and restore the reference memory and nominal environment.
manual_activity: Qualified operator installs the 1DPC population, controls the chamber/rails, supervises stress and restores the reference configuration.
required_inputs: Approved 1DPC socket/channel/slot and DIMM serial/PN/capacity map
SST version/profile, allocation size and NUMA coverage
ECC/RAS/MCE, thermal, OOM, bandwidth and heartbeat limits
safety_requirements: Power down and discharge before DIMM handling
Use ESD procedure and qualified personnel
Use calibrated rail/temperature measurements and OOB access
Preserve logs and restore nominal rails before hardware rework
agent_execution_scope: May validate inventory and analyze workload/ECC artifacts
Must not manipulate DIMMs or lab controls and must not set DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent-only execution but does not prove every installed channel is exercised.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the pinned all-memory SST profile after 1DPC training and low-rail stability are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All DIMMs in 1DPC, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate socket/channel inventory and memory-controller ECC telemetry with measured workload coverage throughout the negative-margin interval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable DIMM topology, ESD/training checks, workload coverage, ECC/thermal limits and controlled restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: High aggregate memory use does not prove every channel/DIMM is exercised; a nominal-voltage or different population result is not equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Undervoltage can manifest as retraining, corrected ECC accumulation or throttling before a tool reports a fatal error.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines the supported 1DPC population, allowed corrected-error delta, reserved OS memory and whether the reference DIMM configuration must be reinstated after test.
expected_evidence: Pre/post 1DPC socket-channel-DIMM identity and usable capacity
Per-controller utilization, ECC/MCE/RAS, thermal and tool results
Restored reference population and nominal post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria align on all-DIMM 1DPC negative-margin stress; exact population and thresholds are missing implementation inputs, not contradictions.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row24 Wistron-Margin-00023-V002: approve 1DPC DIMM serial/PN/capacity socket-channel-slot map, supported population/training expectations, SST version/profile/allocation/NUMA coverage for 12 hours, 40C/-5% tolerances, ECC/RAS/MCE/thermal/OOM limits, abort and memory/environment restoration.

review_improvement: Turns 'all DIMMs' into traceable channel-level coverage and protects configuration, evidence and recovery during negative-margin testing.
independent_technical_reasoning: A memory workload can allocate heavily while leaving one NUMA node or channel lightly exercised. Negative rail margin can also increase corrected ECC or trigger retraining without a hang. The review therefore requires topology-linked workload and controller-level telemetry rather than only SST completion.
